title: TO OUR 3 MILLION KONTIGO USERS IN VENEZUELA
summary: TO OUR 3 MILLION KONTIGO USERS IN VENEZUELA
body_markdown:
Kontigo, Inc. would like to reassure our community, which now exceeds 3.4 million users.


Kontigo, Inc. and its app continue to operate normally and will continue to do so, with its management team fully in charge of the company.


Our users’ funds remain in their wallets; they are their sole property and under their control. Kontigo, Inc. does not hold these funds in custody nor does it have any influence or control over them.


Kontigo, Inc. operates, in every country where required by law, through duly licensed business partners. In Venezuela, that partner is Oha Technology, C.A., a Venezuelan company with which Kontigo, Inc. has a contractual relationship.


Currently, Oha Technology, C.A. operations involving conversion into bolivars and local rails are temporarily suspended. We understand this is due to an ongoing administrative procedure initiated by their local regulator regarding transactions conducted outside the Kontigo ecosystem, transactions that do not involve Kontigo, Inc., its directors, or its shareholders.


We respect the course of this procedure and, at the same time, are working alongside duly regulated entities to explore alternatives that will allow us to restore national currencies to the Kontigo App, owned by Kontigo, Inc., as soon as possible with the utmost respect for the competent authorities.


It is worth noting that our users can transfer their funds through the other available channels in the Kontigo App’s withdrawal process, with current fees set at zero cost.


We understand the concerns and difficulties this situation is causing for our users, and we are working to address them. We are in constant communication and are fully cooperating with the relevant authorities, as well as with duly licensed entities, to restore service as soon as possible.


We will keep you informed as the service restoration process progresses. We apologize for the inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.


Equipo Kontigo


El equipo de Kontigo publica contenidos sobre dinero digital, stablecoins, pagos internacionales e inclusión financiera.
